x: He won all but three races, losing only to Australian Garry Bentley (NCAA College Division champion from South Dakota State), Kenyan Mike Boit, and US Olympians Frank Shorter, Doug Brown and Jeff Galloway - these three in the AAU.

With "Montreal '76" looming ahead, US Olympic marathon champion Frank Shorter, a lawyer by profession, has upset the Olympic applecart by publicly admitting that he has received £100 per month while touring Europe and disclosing that another American, a sprinter, has collected £6,000.

He will spend six weeks in Mexico City training at high altitude with the Polish steeplechasers, at the invitation of one of the favourites for the event in Montreal, Bronislaw Malinowski, and following this he will move on to the United States to stay with Olympic Marathon champion Frank Shorter.
